script.cover_1: Your manager wants your personal number. Must you give it?
script.payoff: Asking is common, and offering another route first is a fair answer.
script.caption: A boundary stated kindly is still a boundary. Send this to the friend who gives out numbers to avoid awkwardness.
script.situation: Can your manager insist on your personal number?
script.answer: Asking is common. Whether you must give it may depend on company policy, so read it before you refuse.
script.reply_me: I would like to keep calls on the office line. Can we use the team chat for urgent things?
